# Getting Help

Plugwerk is in active development (Phase 2). The fastest way to get an
answer depends on what you need.

## Where to Ask

| Type | Channel |
| --- | --- |
| Questions on usage, design, "is this the right approach?" | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/plugwerk/discussions) on the relevant repository |
| Reproducible bugs | A GitHub issue on the affected repository |
| Concrete feature requests with a clear use case | A GitHub issue on the affected repository |
| Suspected security vulnerabilities | See the [Security Policy](./SECURITY.md) — **do not open a public issue** |
| Commercial licensing inquiries | <info@devtank42.de> |

## Before Opening an Issue

1. Search existing [open and closed issues](https://github.com/plugwerk)
   for the repo first — your question may already be answered.
2. Read the repo's `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or `CLAUDE.md`. Most
   common questions are covered there.
3. For bugs, gather the version (commit SHA), environment (OS, JVM /
   Node version), and a minimal reproduction before filing.

## Response Expectations

Plugwerk is maintained by a small team. Issues and discussions are
addressed on a best-effort basis. There is **no support SLA** for
open-source use.

If you need guaranteed response times, dedicated support, or
custom-development services, reach out to <info@devtank42.de> to
discuss commercial-support options.
